text:
fiona: Heads-up — customer reported bulk "replay" from Console attributing charges to org when the intent was to bill individual projects. Repro below.
fiona: Repro steps: Console -> Bulk Replay -> upload CSV (requests with project=proj-a, proj-b) -> toggle 'Run as: Service Account' -> choose delegated SA: sa-batcher@org-acme -> run -> dashboards show a single spike on org:org-acme.
fiona: Example log snippet from billing router:
```
[2026-04-02T16:02:11Z] req=req_0xfeed claims={"sa":"sa-batcher","effective_project":null,"org":"org-acme"} decision=charge_target=org-acme reason=bulk_replay_no_project_claim
```
fiona: Wrapped headers seen at ingress: `Authorization: Bearer batcher-token; X-Console-Bulk=true; X-Console-Project=proj-a` but downstream router sees `effective_project=null`.
dez: This sounds like precedence problem + our batch replay tool strips per-request project header to avoid header spoofing during batching. We originally flattened headers to a single baton header for throughput.
marc: Flattening was to reduce cardinality in router cache (we convert different X-Console-Project per request into one aggregate header on the batch message). But that loses per-request billing attribution. We need to preserve per-item billing metadata for quota.
rachel-support: Customer impact: Support ticket #5432 from Acme — they had to refund usage for a marketing campaign. We need detection + possible credits.
ops-bot: ci/cd: batch-service v2.6 and router v3.30 planned canary at 02:00 UTC. Feature-flag gates available.
dez: Proposal A (short): Add per-item metadata envelope when sending to router: include a small bitmap or compressed list of project ids, and router expands per-request routing decisions. Downside: increases payload size and router logic.
dez: Proposal B (fast): For Console bulk replay flows, mint ephemeral per-request tokens embedding `effective_project` claim at enqueue time and pass those tokens with each request in the batch. Router will then use token claim precedence and attribution remains correct. Requires keygen change but minimal router work.
marc: I prefer B for speed and isolation. Keygen change: add an endpoint to bulk-service that mints short-lived delegated tokens (10m) with claim `effective_project=proj-x` validated against the user/project. Keygen rate limits must be considered.
fiona: Can we also add a temporary server-side flag to let SRE force project mapping for a known replay job for immediate customer remediation? Something like `X-Force-Replay-Project` applied only by ops.
marc: We can add a one-time admin-only replay patch to reattribute usage by replay_job_id. That will be part of the remediation runbook.
rachel-support: For customer comms: need detection query to find replays with charge_target=org-acme in last 30 days and list top affected projects and request ids. Also need a small FAQ blurb explaining the issue and mitigation steps.
dez: Telemetry changes: 1) Add quota event field `billing_path` with enum {token_claim, header, batch_aggregate, sa_owner}. 2) Add `replay_job_id` and `original_project` tags for batch flows so dashboards can roll up. Those fields will help quantify impact and verify fix.
marc: Also add an alert for canary: if fraction of batch requests charged via batch_aggregate > 0.1% in canary cohort, auto-rollback.
ops-bot: reminder: include feature flags `authz:bulk-token-claims` and `authz:replay-batch-envelope` for gradual rollout.
fiona: UX ask: Console bulk replay UI should show a confirmation when "Run as Service Account" is selected: "This replay will be billed to the service account's default org unless per-request projects are preserved. To ensure per-request billing, enable 'Preserve per-request project' or use per-request tokens." Link to docs. Small change avoids surprises.
marc: Security note: When minting per-item tokens, ensure caller has project membership and rate-limit token issuance to avoid abuse. Add audit log entries mapping minted token -> user -> project -> replay_job_id.
dez: Plan of record: 1) Short-term: add replay reattribute admin job + detection query + support FAQ. 2) Medium-term: implement B: bulk-service calls keygen to mint per-request tokens w/ effective_project claim; add telemetry `billing_path`, `replay_job_id`, `original_project`. 3) Console UX banner + confirmation. 4) Canary behind `authz:bulk-token-claims` with monitor and rollback.
ops-bot: next steps: create rollout ticket, tag #support #billing, schedule runbook review with SRE.
fiona: I'll open PRs for the detection query + support copy. ETA 6h for detection, 12h for keygen prototype.
rachel-support: We'll draft customer email and hold credits until we have a full list. Thanks for fast triage :pray: :thumbsup:
